register.reg_long_name: Counter-timer Physical Secure Timer TimerValue Register
register.reg_condition: when EL3 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Holds the timer value for the secure physical timer, usually accessible at EL3 but configurably accessible at EL1 in Secure state.

field_description.para: The TimerValue view of the secure physical timer.
On a read of this register:

listitem.content: If CNTPS_CTL_EL1.ENABLE is 0, the value returned is UNKNOWN.
If CNTPS_CTL_EL1.ENABLE is 1, the value returned is (CNTPS_CVAL_EL1 - CNTPCT_EL0).

field_description.para: On a write of this register, CNTPS_CVAL_EL1 is set to (CNTPCT_EL0 + TimerValue), where TimerValue is treated as a signed 32-bit integer.

When CNTPS_CTL_EL1.ENABLE is 1, the timer condition is met when (CNTPCT_EL0 - CNTPS_CVAL_EL1) is greater than or equal to zero. This means that TimerValue acts like a 32-bit downcounter timer. When the timer condition is met:

listitem.content: If CNTPS_CTL_EL1.IMASK is 0, an interrupt is generated.

field_description.para: When CNTPS_CTL_EL1.ENABLE is 0, the TimerValue cannot be read but continues to decrement. When the timer is enabled, the TimerValue represents the elapsed time whether that time was spent enabled or disabled.
